abstract: <jats:p>The financial services sector is experiencing unprecedented transformation through cloud-driven automation, fundamentally reshaping how banking institutions manage infrastructure security, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience in an increasingly digital marketplace. This article examines the comprehensive implementation of AWS automation solutions within financial institutions, analyzing multi-account cloud architectures, AI-powered fraud detection systems, and automated compliance frameworks that address the complex operational challenges facing modern banking environments. The article explores how financial institutions leverage AWS Organizations, Control Tower, and Service Control Policies to establish scalable governance structures while implementing sophisticated AI and machine learning capabilities through Amazon Fraud Detector and SageMaker for real-time transaction monitoring and anomaly detection. Through detailed analysis of regulatory compliance automation using AWS Audit Manager, Config, and CloudTrail, the article demonstrates how institutions achieve continuous compliance monitoring while reducing manual oversight burdens and audit preparation costs. The article reveals that successful cloud automation implementations require careful balance between security requirements and operational performance, with particular attention to disaster recovery strategies, high availability architectures, and comprehensive risk management frameworks that ensure business continuity during various failure scenarios. Case study analysis illustrates both the substantial benefits and significant challenges associated with large-scale cloud migration projects, highlighting the critical importance of organizational change management, staff training, and phased implementation approaches that minimize business disruption while maximizing automation benefits. The article indicates that financial institutions achieving optimal results prioritize foundational security and governance capabilities before implementing advanced AI features, while maintaining architectural flexibility to adapt to evolving regulatory expectations and emerging technology opportunities. This article contributes to understanding how cloud automation technologies can enhance banking infrastructure security and compliance while providing strategic insights for institutions navigating the complex intersection of technological innovation, regulatory requirements, and competitive market pressures in the modern financial services landscape.</jats:p>
title: Cloud Automation in Financial Services: Securing and Scaling Banking Infrastructure in AWS
